missing_methods.intent: Locate profile name element in dashboard header
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Locate and return the WebElement for the profile name in the dashboard header. This method should use the appropriate locator strategy to find the profile name element and return the element object for further operations like visibility checks or text extraction.

missing_methods.intent: Assert profile name text matches expected value
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: Assert that the profile name text displayed in the dashboard header matches the expected value. This method should retrieve the text from the profile name element using get_user_profile_name() and perform an assertion comparing it with the expected_name parameter. Should raise an assertion error if the values do not match.
